fields.description: Tranquil Beach Residences is a beachfront apartment release on Sobha Siniya Island in Umm Al Quwain. One- to three-bedroom homes combine enclosed suites with balconies or terraces, with outlooks across the lagoon and landscaped setting depending on position. The project has its own plan collection and is separate from The Tranquil at Sobha Central in Dubai.

research.community: Tranquil Beach Residences · Sobha Siniya Island
overview: The reviewed three-bedroom Type A is a terrace apartment, not a duplex: its published 2,190.7 sq ft total includes 874.5 sq ft of outdoor space. Smaller Type A apartments use much narrower balconies. The tower diagram identifies unit-specific outlooks; a water view is not promised for every home.
research.locationNote: Sobha Siniya Island, Umm Al Quwain, is established by the own developer page. Shared island facilities, access and opening arrangements require confirmation.
research.priceNote: The own project page advertises AED 1.40 million, subject to available inventory. Impala’s dated broker selection is slightly above that rounded guide. Neither establishes that a particular apartment is currently available through Aliyas at the published amount.
research.paymentNote: Impala gives 20% booking, 40% during construction and 40% handover. This totals 100%, but it is a broker reference; the official page and own brochure do not supply a current dated instalment calendar. Government fees and administration terms require separate confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The own brochure explicitly prints ACD December 2030; the broker reference agrees with Q4 2030. Anticipated completion is distinct from possession arrangements and the buyer’s contractual date.
